# Phantom Secrets

Your agent can call the API. The key stays in a local vault.

Phantom replaces managed secrets in `.env` with `phm_` placeholders. A proxy on `127.0.0.1` adds the vault value only to the auth header of a matched route. Secret values are not printed, logged, or returned to a model.

## 30-second start

```bash
brew tap ashlrai/phantom && brew trust --formula ashlrai/phantom/phantom && brew install ashlrai/phantom/phantom
phantom init
phantom setup --client claude
phantom status --json
phantom list --json
phantom check --log agent-transcript.jsonl --json
```

Linux and Windows installs, and the limits of each package channel, are in [docs/distribution-status.md](docs/distribution-status.md).

`phantom status --json`, `phantom list --json`, and `phantom check --log` are value-free. The log scan reports the file, the line, and the credential shape. The same scan is MCP `phantom_check` with `log_path`.
